prompt: Create a Rust daemon that uses systemd socket activation to accept TCP connections on port 9090. It should be a simple echo server — read lines from clients and echo them back. Generate both the .service and .socket unit files. Make sure it falls back to binding its own socket when not launched via systemd.

assertions.text: Output includes a .socket systemd unit file with ListenStream on port 9090
Output includes a .service systemd unit file
Source code reads LISTEN_FDS environment variable for socket activation
Source code falls back to binding its own socket when LISTEN_FDS is not set
Source code implements line-based echo (read line, write it back)
Source code uses FromRawFd or equivalent to adopt systemd-provided file descriptors
